name: TA-5-width-clearance-wide
why: The layout of TA-5-width-clearance-narrow with a 2.5 m vehicle width (radius 1.25 m). Clearance is measured to the excluded cell rectangles and to the survey edge. The gap cell (3,4) is 0.5 m from the wall above and below it, so it is refused; columns 3 and 5 are 0.5 m from the wall, rows 0 and 6 and columns 0 and 8 are 0.5 m from the survey edge. What remains is columns 1-2 and 6-7 of rows 1-5 (1.5 m or more from every wall cell and edge): 20 cells, two disconnected 2 x 5 blocks. Start (3,1) and end (3,7) are eligible, so the outcome is a genuine NO_ROUTE, not a START/END block.
